subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Compressors: Squeezing Gas
description: A short lesson to help you apply Compressors: Squeezing Gas.

hook.text: A pump moves liquid. A compressor does the same for gas — under pressure.

buildup.text: Pistons, screws, or spinning impellers squeeze gas into smaller volumes.

discovery.text: Compressing gas heats it up. That heat must be removed or it wastes energy.

twist.text: Multi-stage compressors cool gas between stages to save up to 30% of power.

climax.text: Refrigerators, air tools, and natural gas pipelines all need compressors.

punchline.text: Squeeze gas small, keep it cool, and move it anywhere.

quiz.question: Why do multi-stage compressors cool gas between stages?
options: Hot gas expands and undoes the compression work
Cooling dense gas between stages reduces the energy needed for further compression
The compressor seals melt at high temperatures
